newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles has further board nomination.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles has further board nomination.

text.p: Australian retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Monday it had received a nomination for the election of Peter Willcocks as a director at this year's annual meeting to be held in Sydney on November 19.
Willcocks, a Melbourne lawyer, failed to win a board seat at Coles Myer's annual meeting last year, when there was a massive boardroom shake-up.

Seven Coles directors are to stand for re-election at next month's meeting -- Dennis Eck, Nick Greiner, Solomon Lew, Stan Wallis, Peter Morgan and recent director appointees Paul Collins and Martyn Myer. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
